params.body:
Replaces #216, which failed CI on code style only (Pint on app/Models/Article.php); the change is otherwise the same, and `vendor/bin/pint --test` passes on the whole repo.

The front page's posts under the lead can now include posts an editor kept at a place in the Studio (pipeline: `articles.front_place`). This shows them there.

## Change

- Migration: `articles.front_place` (nullable). The projection maps it from the pipeline's article.
- `Article::frontPage($under)`: the lead (as `leadFirst`), then `$under` places. A kept post stands at its place; the others fill newest first, so a new post takes the first free place and the number of posts the editors chose holds. A post kept beyond the last place takes its turn by date.
- Both homes use it: the member home with the editors' number, the visitor home with two places after the lead.

## Checks

- `tests/Feature/FrontPlacesTest.php` (4): a kept post at its place with the rest by date; a new post takes the first free place and the count holds; a place beyond the count goes by date; the visitor home keeps places too.
- `PinnedLeadTest` and `FrontSizesTest` unchanged and green (17/17 together).
- Full suite: only `BuildStampTest` fails locally, as it does in any worktree.

Without kept places the order is exactly as before. Merge after the pipeline PR.
params.title: Front page: posts kept at a place stand there, the rest fill by date
